articles.summary: Castle Creek Capital, an alternative asset management firm focused on the financial services sector, with a specialization in the community banking industry, announced today that Castle Creek managed funds have acquired, from legacy stockholders, $40 million of common stock in FirstSun Capital Bancorp (the Company or FirstSun).
